## ResourceNullabilityResult.truncated property

Whether the sample of items stopped early because the time ran out. Only the sample sets it: a pre-scan of a nested resource that ran out of time shows as status `budget` when it found no item, or as a note when the items it found were then read in full.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly truncated: boolean;
```
